```markdown
# SEC filing ingestion — Roadmap

## Outcomes

Source: your partner's words, 2026-11-06. Background: specs/sec-filing-index-ingestion-spec.md (covers O1 only; its §2.2 excludes document downloads and text extraction, and your partner's progression overrides that for O2–O3), specs/sec-filing-index-ingestion-adr.md (Proposed, not accepted).
Choices made: Python 3.14 uv workspace with four empty package scaffolds (from the repository).

| # | Outcome | Track | Rank | Cost (estimate; basis) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| O1 | The quarterly and daily index files, ingested into one filing-index table | A | 1 | Small: about 135 quarterly files since 1993 plus one daily file per business day, minutes at 3 req/s (SEC full-index and daily-index directories); measured by Stage 1 |
| O2 | The individual submissions that the index rows name, downloaded | A | 2 | Large: millions of files, weeks at 3 req/s for full history (index row count × request rate); measured per quarter by Stage 2 |
| O3 | 10-K and 8-K filings picked out of the submissions, with their main documents extracted | A | 3 | Unknown until submissions are on disk; measured by Stage 3 |

Tracks: A — SEC filing ingestion (known progression). Ranked in the order your partner gave.

## Stages

- [ ] Stage 1: Index table on real data
      Objective: Ingest every real quarterly and daily master index into one filing-index table.
      Outcomes: O1
      Consumes: nothing (package scaffolds only)
      Produces: the filing-index table; specs/sec-filing-ingestion-stage-1-findings.md
      Exit: the table holds the rows of every quarterly master index from 1993Q1 through the last closed quarter and of every daily index listed since, with each source's row count matching its file's data lines; the findings record the real run's download time, bytes, rows and request rate.
      Leaves out: index manifest and replay, quarterly reconciliation, versioned quarter publication, index golden-fixture validation (Stage 4); shared request budget, scheduled runs, deployment and monitoring (Stage 6)
      ROUTING: brainstorming

- [ ] Stage 2: Submission download
      Objective: Download the submissions that the filing-index table's rows name.
      Outcomes: O2
      Consumes: Stage 1's filing-index table and findings
      Produces: submissions on disk with a per-row downloaded, failed or pending status; specs/sec-filing-ingestion-stage-2-findings.md
      Exit: every submission named by the table for one real quarter is downloaded or carries a failed or pending status; an interrupted run resumes without re-downloading completed files; the findings record bytes, hours per quarter and the full-history projection.
      Leaves out: submission and document provenance (Stage 5); shared request budget, scheduled runs, deployment and monitoring (Stage 6)
      ROUTING: brainstorming

- [ ] Stage 3: 10-K and 8-K handling
      Objective: Pick 10-K and 8-K filings out of the downloaded submissions and extract their main documents.
      Outcomes: O3
      Consumes: Stage 2's downloaded quarter and its statuses
      Produces: extracted main documents for 10-K and 8-K filings; specs/sec-filing-ingestion-stage-3-findings.md
      Exit: for Stage 2's quarter, every 10-K and 8-K submission has its main document extracted or is counted among those where none was identified; the findings record that count and the run's time.
      Leaves out: submission and document provenance, extraction replay (Stage 5); scheduled runs, deployment and monitoring (Stage 6)
      ROUTING: brainstorming

- [ ] Stage 4: Index integrity
      Objective: Add the index manifest and replay, quarterly reconciliation, versioned quarter publication and index golden-fixture validation, with the background spec §4.2 and §4.4–4.6 as the design input.
      Outcomes: O1
      Consumes: Stage 1's table and findings; Stages 2–3 as readers of the table
      Produces: versioned quarter publication behind one active pointer, which Stages 5–6 and the Stage 2–3 code read through
      Exit: re-ingesting a changed quarterly file records additions and updates and holds any withdrawal for approval; a parser-version change rebuilds from stored bytes with zero SEC requests; readers, including the Stage 2–3 code, resolve each quarter through the active pointer; golden fixtures cover every index format in the loaded range.
      Leaves out: shared request budget, scheduled runs, deployment and monitoring (Stage 6)
      ROUTING: brainstorming

- [ ] Stage 5: Submission and document traceability
      Objective: Add submission and document provenance and extraction replay.
      Outcomes: O2, O3
      Consumes: Stage 2's submissions, Stage 3's extracted documents, Stage 4's active pointer
      Produces: provenance linking each submission and extracted document to its index row and source bytes; replayable extraction
      Exit: every downloaded submission and extracted document traces to its index row and content hash; an extractor change re-extracts from stored submissions with zero SEC requests.
      Leaves out: shared request budget, scheduled runs, deployment and monitoring (Stage 6)
      ROUTING: brainstorming

- [ ] Stage 6: Scheduled operation and deployment
      Objective: Run index, submission and 10-K/8-K ingestion on schedule under the shared request budget, deployed with monitoring on the platform the ADR settles (background spec §4.1, §4.3, §4.7–4.9, §7).
      Outcomes: O1, O2, O3
      Consumes: Stages 1–5
      Produces: the deployed, scheduled system and its release record
      Exit: consecutive scheduled daily runs ingest new index files, download their submissions and extract new 10-K and 8-K documents, each with a durable run report; concurrent collectors together stay at or under the configured request rate; the full-history submission backfill runs as a resumable campaign; the release record names image and configuration versions.
      Leaves out: nothing
      ROUTING: brainstorming

## Stage-spec stamp

Every stage spec's Rollout note carries this line, which writing-plans copies verbatim into the stage plan's header:

> Roadmap: specs/sec-filing-ingestion-roadmap.md, Stage N — on plan completion, tick the stage and re-validate later stages against what shipped.

## Completion

With every stage ticked, run derive-roadmap §6 over the Outcomes list: each of O1–O3 gets a verdict with evidence (implementing stage and plan, Deviation notes, deferred_items entries). An unmet outcome exits as a new stage or as a conscious deferral with a written why.
```
